messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p95 latency breach crossing SLO (global p95 >= 1.3s) sustained 4m. Auto-routing fallback kicked in. Paging @oncall_sam :rotating_light:

oncall_sam: got it, looking at global dashboards. tagging @sre_julia and @eng_model. which regions are seeing the spike?

sre_julia: eu and ap-southeast are showing the worst tails. unusual routing churn visible in the last 3m.

eng_model: routing traces indicate fallback routed traffic to ap fallback pool and selected variant redwood-xxl-q6 for many requests. q6 was chosen by cost-priority because perf profile shows lower nominal cost, but its p95 is higher under burst concurrency.

oncall_sam: that matches the customer pings - we have 2 enterprise suites reporting sluggish chat responses. can we disable auto-fallback until we stabilize?

infra_deploy: executing temporary policy hold:
```
POST /internal/policies/modify
Authorization: Bearer ####
{"policy":"global-latency-fallback","action":"hold","reason":"incident 1725552468 - hold fallback"}
```

infra_deploy: policy hold accepted. edge propagation ~10s.

product_support: impact note for CS: affected window ~00:18:00, approx 3.2% of global requests, p95 peaked ~1.8s. preparing customer advisory.

cs_ana: will draft message for impacted customers in EU/AP. flagging top 5 accounts for outreach.

eng_model: root cause hypothesis: perf-profile metadata for redwood-q6 family stale after last metrics ingestion; cost model decision boundary too tight so small cost delta flipped selection. moreover, regional fallback routing amplified queuing at those hosts causing tail spike.

sre_julia: two-pronged mitigation: 1) stop automatic fallback (done), 2) raise variant selection hysteresis and cooldown so tiny score deltas don't flip traffic. eng_model can you push comparator change to canary?

eng_model: deploying comparator change to canary with parameters min_score_delta=0.05, cooldown_s=45. command:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/routing/comparator/deploy \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ####' \\
  -d '{"min_delta":0.05,"cooldown":45,"target":"canary"}'
```

infra_deploy: comparator canary rollout started (id=cmp-903). logs:
```
[00:00] canary nodes selected
[00:08] comparator image pulled
[00:40] comparator running on 12% of edges
[00:46] healthchecks OK
```

product_support: timeline note: incident open 1725552468, fallback hold 1725552490, comparator canary deploy 1725552608.

eng_model: early canary metrics show variant flip-rate down 80% and p95 trending toward baseline (~0.95s). promoting to 50% to further validate.

sre_julia: monitoring for unintended side-effects. adding temporary alert to watch variant_flip_rate > 4/min.

oncall_sam: once stable, we should re-enable fallback with stricter params. prepare enable command with hysteresis in place.

eng_model: promoting comparator to 50% (deploy id=cmp-903-promote).

infra_deploy: promote succeeded. edge propagation ~16s.

cs_ana: customers updated. a few replied appreciating the proactive outreach. no formal escalations opened.

eng_model: after promotion, p95 returned to ~0.98s within 5m. network traces: https://internal.redwood/traces/1725552468.

oncall_sam: re-enable fallback with constraints:
```
POST /internal/policies/modify
Authorization: Bearer ####
{"policy":"global-latency-fallback","action":"enable","params":{"min_score_delta":0.05,"cooldown_s":45},"reason":"re-enable after comparator deploy"}
```

infra_deploy: fallback re-enabled. propagation ~12s.

product_support: final impact: 18m window of elevated p95 with peak ~1.8s, approx 3.2% of requests impacted, no errors or data loss, customer experience degraded for some interactive workloads.

eng_model: immediate action items:
- manual perf-profile refresh for q6 family (in progress)
- add pre-deploy simulation that tests perf profiles under burst concurrency
- add canary gate to perf-profile updates (block global rollout until pass)

sre_julia: ops action items:
- create alert for variant_flip_rate > 3/min to page earlier
- add pre-fallback paging threshold: if p95 > 1.1s for 3m, page oncall and hold fallback until ack
- include variant selection delta metric in dashboards

product_support: comms: CS sent targeted messages to impacted accounts and internal summary to eng+support team. scheduled incident blameless postmortem tomorrow 10:30 UTC.

oncall_sam: handing to @sre_julia for post-incident monitoring and follow-ups. oncall span ~38m.

sre_julia: taking ownership. will track action items in the incident board and coordinate RCA.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: routing-induced latency spike mitigated. incident duration ~00:38:00. tags: routing,fallback,variant-selection,hysteresis

eng_model: logs and artifacts: https://internal-redwood/artifacts/1725552468 (perf logs, routing traces, comparator diff).

cs_ana: closing loop with customers; no escalations outstanding.

oncall_sam: great response team. follow-ups assigned: eng_model (perf-profile RB), sre_julia (alerts + paging config), product_support (customer comms). closing thread. :white_check_mark:
